fields.title: Rose & Activated Charcoal
fields.description: Handmade cold process soap with rose and activated charcoal.
fields.ingredients: Olive oil, coconut oil, shea butter, sodium hydroxide, water, rose essential oil, activated charcoal
fields.instructions: Weigh the oils and melt them. Mix the sodium hydroxide with water carefully. Combine the lye solution with the oils and stir until trace. Add the rose essential oil and activated charcoal. Pour into the mould and leave to cure.

fields.title: Basic Lavender Cold Process Bar
fields.description: A simple, gentle everyday cold process soap recipe suitable for beginners.
fields.ingredients:
300g Olive Oil
150g Coconut Oil
50g Shea Butter
70g Sodium Hydroxide (Lye)
160g Distilled Water
10g Lavender Essential Oil
fields.instructions:
1. Carefully mix sodium hydroxide into distilled water in a well-ventilated space and let cool to 100°F.
2. Melt coconut oil and shea butter, then combine with olive oil.
3. Pour lye solution into oils and blend with a stick blender until light trace.
4. Stir in lavender essential oil.
5. Pour into mould, insulate for 24 hours, cut into bars, and cure for 4–6 weeks.

fields.title: Luxury Honey Oat & Silk Bar
fields.description: An ultra-nourishing premium recipe enriched with colloidal oatmeal, raw honey, and tussah silk.
fields.ingredients:
250g Olive Oil
150g Coconut Oil
75g Sweet Almond Oil
25g Cocoa Butter
72g Sodium Hydroxide (Lye)
150g Goat Milk (Frozen)
1 tbsp Colloidal Oatmeal
1 tbsp Raw Honey
Pinch of Tussah Silk
fields.instructions:
1. Dissolve silk into lye solution prepared with slushy frozen goat milk to avoid scorching.
2. Combine melted oils and butter at 90°F.
3. Add colloidal oatmeal and raw honey directly to warm oils and blend thoroughly.
4. Pour lye-milk solution into oils and bring to medium trace.
5. Pour into log mould and place in freezer for 12 hours to prevent overheating from honey sugars.
